title: 第一卷 第11章 苏巧巧第一卷 第12章 第一次制符
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: 用了两个时辰，林寻将占地十里的坊市浏览一遍，至于再往后，就是生活区，他没法过去。
坊市内最显眼的高大建筑有：万宝楼，百炼坊，千机楼，丹鼎阁，惜春楼......
这些建筑最为庞大，与李氏仙族有着千丝万缕的关系，里面的人也是最多，来来往往络绎不绝。
再往下就是一些小店铺，零星的坐落在坊市内。
当然最多的还是地上摊位，不时有人吆喝两声，与凡俗市井无异。
主干道上，零零散散的路过修仙者。
儒生，和尚，道士......
老人，女人，小孩......
负剑的，背着酒红大葫芦的，带着灵禽的，骑着妖兽的.......
五光十色，不一而足。
林寻始终低着头，尽量不去盯着别人，免得造成误会。
他已修炼数十年，看待问题的角度早已变化。
从路过人的灵气波动可以辨别，炼气中期，炼气中期，炼气后期......
这些都不是他能惹的，哪怕是有炼气初期的人，也带着奴役，或者跟着长辈。
只有他是单独的炼气一层。
在这个实力为尊的世界，实力低就是不好混！
偏偏识海内的宝树，常有异动，林寻只能控制着自己，不去看那些女修。
好在他的自制力不错，不一会就主动屏蔽了宝树的感知。
现在倒是可以确信，宝树可以结新枝，而且与女修相关的概率大多了。
可惜，这些女修怎么会看上他这个糟老头子？
还是自家芸儿好。
林寻在各个摊位闲逛，并暗中记下价格，很快就有了大概了解。
下品符箓，0.5~3块下品灵石，增加遁术的最贵，也最难画，攻击和防御性质的次之，恢复类的最便宜，也好画。
中品符箓，5~15块下品灵石，这个就不太一样了，攻击的最贵，防御和遁术次之，恢复倒是同样最便宜。
毕竟，进攻就是最好的防守。
除了这个，拿最常用的炼气丹药养气丹来说，一粒需要一灵石。
再看看自己手中灵石，啧。
穷！
收起心思，林寻才前往坊市中最大的建筑——万宝楼。
刚进去，就有一女修挂着职业性的微笑迎上来，“道友想买什么？”
女修虽是炼气四层，但也没看不起炼气一层的林寻，毕竟万宝楼的招牌就是来者是客。
“要一本《长春功》的全套炼气功法。”
女修闻言，转身从身后柜子里取出一本功法。
“二十枚下品灵石，可修至炼气大圆满！”
“多少？”林寻的面色一僵。
长春功是大路货色，在仙宗内兑换全本，也就相当于五块下品灵石。
没想到，这里居然要二十枚下品灵石。
女修温声解释道：“此功法虽然修炼进度缓慢，需要的资粮甚多，
但胜在稳定，可达炼气圆满的整本功法，在坊市中可不多见，与其他功法相比，既能延寿......”
林寻很快就听明白了意思，与仙宗相比，这坊市中能到炼气圆满的功法本就不多，还多有残缺和隐患。
也就是说，仙宗的垃圾玩意，在这还成了宝贝。
content_en:
It took Lin Xun two hours to browse through the ten-mile market. As for the living area beyond, he couldn't get past it.
The most conspicuous tall buildings in Fang City include: Wanbao Tower, Bailianfang, Qianji Tower, Danding Pavilion, Xichun Tower...
These buildings are the largest and are inextricably related to the Li Immortal Clan. They also have the largest number of people inside, and there is an endless stream of people coming and going.
Further down are some small shops, scattered throughout the city.
Of course, the most common stalls are the stalls on the ground. From time to time, someone shouts, just like in an ordinary market.
On the main road, scattered cultivators passed by.
Confucian scholars, monks, Taoist priests...
Old people, women, children...
Those carrying swords, those carrying wine-red gourds, those carrying spiritual birds, those riding monsters...
There are so many colors.
Lin Xun always lowered his head, trying not to stare at others to avoid misunderstandings.
He has been practicing for decades, and his perspective on problems has already changed.
It can be distinguished from the fluctuations of spiritual energy of passers-by, in the middle stage of Qi refining, in the middle stage of Qi refining, in the late stage of Qi refining...
These are not things he can mess with, even those who are in the early stages of Qi refining are still enslaved or following their elders.
He is the only one with a separate level of Qi refining.
In this world where strength is respected, low strength means it is difficult to get along!
However, the treasure trees in the sea were often moving, so Lin Xun could only control himself and not look at the female cultivators.
Fortunately, he had good self-control, and he took the initiative to block Baoshu's perception after a while.
Now I can be sure that the treasure tree can bear new branches, and the probability of it being related to female cultivators is much higher.
It's a pity, how could these female nuns fall in love with such a bad old man like him?
It’s better to have my own Yun’er.
Lin Xun wandered around various stalls and secretly wrote down the prices, and soon had a general understanding.
Low-grade talismans, 0.5 to 3 pieces of low-grade spiritual stones, those that increase escape skills are the most expensive and the most difficult to draw, followed by those with attack and defense properties, and the ones that restore are the cheapest and easy to draw.
A mid-grade talisman costs 5 to 15 pieces of low-grade spiritual stones. This one is different. The attack one is the most expensive, followed by defense and escape skills, and recovery is also the cheapest.
After all, offense is the best defense.
In addition to this, take the most commonly used Qi-refining pill, Qi-Nourishing Pill, which requires one spirit stone per pill.
Look at the spiritual stone in your hand again, tsk.
poverty!
Putting his thoughts away, Lin Xuncai headed to Wanbao Tower, the largest building in Fang City.
As soon as we entered, a female cultivator came up to us with a professional smile, "What do you want to buy, fellow Taoist?"
Although the female cultivator is on the fourth level of Qi Refining, she doesn't look down on Lin Xun who is on the first level of Qi Refining. After all, Wanbao Tower's signature is that everyone who comes is a guest.
"I want a complete set of Qigong exercises in Changchun Gong."
Upon hearing this, the female cultivator turned around and took out a book of exercises from the cabinet behind her.
"With twenty low-grade spiritual stones, you can cultivate to the perfection of Qi refining!"
"How much?" Lin Xun's face froze.
Changchun Gong is a common commodity, and if you exchange it for the full copy in the Immortal Sect, it is equivalent to five low-grade spiritual stones.
Unexpectedly, there are actually twenty low-grade spiritual stones here.
The female cultivator explained warmly: "Although the practice of this technique is slow and requires a lot of resources,
But the advantage is that it is stable and can achieve complete Qi refining. This whole exercise is rare in the market. Compared with other exercises, it can not only extend life..."
Lin Xun quickly understood the meaning. Compared with the Immortal Sect, there were not many exercises in this city that could achieve perfect Qi refining, and many of them had defects and hidden dangers.
In other words, the garbage items of the Immortal Sect have become treasures here.
